easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Danitha trigger, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
